description: Replace the service areas on a Google Business location. action=update sends the full list (1 to 20 places, each with place_id and place_name from list_google_business_service_areas view=places or a known region Place ID). business_type is CUSTOMER_AND_BUSINESS_LOCATION (customers can visit, and you also travel) or CUSTOMER_LOCATION_ONLY (you only travel to customers). CUSTOMER_LOCATION_ONLY needs region_code when Google has not set one, and clear_storefront_address=true when a street address is still on the listing. The country cannot be changed once set. Preview then confirm: call without confirm to get a preview and preview_id, show it, then call again with confirm=true and that preview_id. Saving the same list again is safe.

account_id.description: Google Business account ID from list_accounts.

action.description: update: replace the service area list.

business_type.description: CUSTOMER_LOCATION_ONLY travels to customers. CUSTOMER_AND_BUSINESS_LOCATION also has a storefront.

clear_storefront_address.description: Set true only when switching to customer-only. Google requires the street address to be removed from the listing in the same update; it is not kept, so adding it back means entering it again.

confirm.description: Leave out to get a preview; true only with the preview_id after the user approved it.

location_id.description: Google Business numeric location id (the location_id/platform_user_id from list_accounts, e.g. "197940849675145390"). NOT the ChIJ... Place ID from list_google_business_reviews view=review_link. Prefer account_id.

places.description: The full replacement list, 1 to 20 areas. Each item needs place_id and place_name.

preview_id.description: The preview_id from the preview call. Required with confirm: true.

region_code.description: Two-letter country code. Required for customer-only listings that do not already have one. Immutable once set.

name: manage_google_business_service_area
